svg.title: Taco Smell Stage 1 logical tile map v0.1
svg.desc: From left to right: dining, kitchen, storage, with Billy near dining start and rear escape at far right. Exact ASCII and JSON files are canonical.
svg.text: Blue P = Billy; red H = starting hazmat; brown = future hazmat
Only the .map and .json define collisions and coordinates. Preview is illustrative.
